checkpoints.requestText: TD01-P3-H3 — APPROVE, DENY, or DEFER ONE exact-image load plus ONE conditional verification on your physical FRDM-MCXN236 via probe SPOBEAQ0BCREX? Requires separate R3 acceptance and native permission. APPROVE also confirms the same physical board/probe association, safe current power/connections, that existing firmware and all affected-sector data may be replaced, and all flash/volatile evidence requiring preservation is already retained; otherwise DEFER with the missing facts. Withdrawn H1 is not reused.
